name: Tallow
author: E. T. Carter
description: A shelf of small candle flames along the lower third — hash-varied teardrop flames with hot pale cores, palette-tinted mantles, and soft breathing halos that pool light on the implied shelf. The deep near-black above is faintly warmed by the gathered glow; at long staggered intervals a flame gutters, snuffs to an ember, sends up a single wavering smoke thread, then slowly relights.

params.label: Flame size
params.effect: Height of each flame in CSS pixels, scaling cores and halos together from votive specks to taper flames.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Amplitude of the gutter-noise bending and brightness jitter; 0 is a windless room of still flames, 1 a draughty one.

params.label: Snuff rate
params.effect: How often a candle snuffs out and sends up its smoke thread; 0 disables snuff events entirely, 1 keeps one dying somewhere most of the time.
